entries.title: Psalms 21:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. The king shall rejoice in Your strength, O LORD; and in Your salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

entries.title: Psalms 21:2
segments: You have given him his heart's desire, and have not withheld the prayer of his lips. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 21:3
segments: For You go before him [with] the blessings of goodness; You set a crown of pure gold on his head.

entries.title: Psalms 21:4
segments: He asked life from You; You give to him length of days forever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 21:5
segments: His glory [is] great in Your salvation; honor and majesty You have laid on him.

entries.title: Psalms 21:6
segments: For You have made him most blessed forever; You have rejoiced him in the gladness in Your holy face.

entries.title: Psalms 21:7
segments: For the king trusts in the LORD, and in the mercy of the Most High; he shall not be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 21:8
segments: Your hand shall find out all Your enemies; Your right hand shall find out those who hate You.

entries.title: Psalms 21:9
segments: You shall make them as a fiery oven in the time of Your presence; the LORD will swallow them up in His wrath, and the fire shall devour them.

entries.title: Psalms 21:10
segments: Their fruit shall You destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the sons of men.

entries.title: Psalms 21:11
segments: For they intended evil against You; they imagined a wicked thing; they are not able to prevail.

entries.title: Psalms 21:12
segments: For You shall make them turn the back; You shall make ready [Your arrows] on Your strings against their faces.

entries.title: Psalms 21:13
segments: Be exalted, O LORD, in Your strength; we will sing, and praise Your power.
